etsy.title: Mini Christmas Stocking Crochet Pattern PDF, Easy Stocking Ornament, Flat Pieces in Single Crochet, Gift Card Holder, English German
etsy.description:
A little stocking for the tree, an advent garland or a gift card: two flat pieces in single crochet, joined and finished with a white cuff and a loop. About 1 hour.

• Skill level: easy (2/6), you need ch, sc, increase and sc2tog
• Size: about 6.5 × 10 cm (2.5 × 4 in) in worsted yarn; bigger in chunky yarn
• Hook: 4 mm
• Yarn: about 8 g red + 3 g white

WAYS TO USE IT: tree ornament, advent calendar garland (make 24), gift card or cash holder, place card on the Christmas table.

PDF PATTERN ONLY – not the finished item. Instant download in English (US terms + UK table) and German (Deutsch).
Includes a stitch chart (symbol diagram), a finished-shape sketch with measurements and a symbol key.
New pattern: the first image is the stitch chart; a maker-tested photo will be added.
For personal use and small-batch handmade sales with credit to AureliaVenn. Please don't share or resell the pattern.

Written with the help of AI tools; stitch counts checked row by row.
